info.title: Kudzu
info.description:
Kudzu decides whether it is safe to deploy a given service to a given environment, and lets a GitHub merge queue enforce that decision. A gate is keyed by (service, environment) and has one effective state, computed with the precedence tripped > manual freeze > scheduled freeze > open. Any non-open state ejects queued pull requests.

Write endpoints always require a bearer token from KUDZU_WRITE_TOKENS. Read endpoints are unauthenticated unless KUDZU_REQUIRE_READ_AUTH is set, in which case they take the same tokens.

post.summary: Clear a manual freeze and reset a tripped breaker
post.description: This is the only way to clear a trip: a successful deploy resets the failure counter but leaves the trip in place.

post.summary: Report a deploy result to the circuit breaker
post.description: A failure increments the consecutive-failure counter and trips the gate once it reaches BREAKER_FAILURE_THRESHOLD. A success resets the counter but does not clear a trip. When a GitHub App is configured, a trip also posts a failing commit status to in-flight merge-group branches of repo, evicting them immediately.

200.description: The gate after recording the result.

400.description: Invalid body, missing service/env, or a status other than success/failed.

get.description: With no service and no env, returns the windows of every known gate. Pass both to narrow it to one gate; passing only one is a 400.

parameters.name: service
parameters.description: Narrow to one gate. Requires env.

parameters.name: env
parameters.description: Narrow to one gate. Requires service.

400.description: Only one of service and env was given.

401.description: Read auth is enabled and the token was missing or wrong.

post.description: Give either cron and duration_seconds for a recurring window, or start and end for a one-off. The cron expression is standard 5-field (minute hour day-of-month month day-of-week); there is no seconds field and no @daily-style descriptors, so `* * * * *` is the shortest valid form.

201.description: The stored window, including the generated id if none was given.

400.description: Invalid body, missing service/env, or a window that is neither a valid cron+duration nor a start+end.

delete.description: Windows are stored per gate, so the service and env locate the collection and the id picks the window within it.

bearerAuth.description: A token from KUDZU_WRITE_TOKENS. Kudzu fails closed: with no tokens configured, every write is rejected.

Gate.description: The effective, computed state of one gate.

state.description: Effective state, computed with the precedence tripped > manual freeze > scheduled freeze > open.

allowed.description: Whether merges are allowed. The merge-queue check reads this field.

reason.description: Why the gate is not open.

expires_at.description: When the state lapses on its own — a freeze TTL, or the end of the active schedule window. Absent for a trip or an open-ended freeze.

reason.description: Shown on the gate and the board.

ttl_seconds.description: Lift the freeze automatically after this many seconds. Omit or 0 for an open-ended freeze.

repo.description: owner/name, used to evict in-flight merge groups on a trip. Without it a trip cannot evict proactively.

base.description: Merge-queue base branch. Defaults to main.

run_url.description: Link back to the CI run.

Schedule.description: A stored freeze window. Exactly one of (start, end) or (cron, duration) is set.

id.description: Window id, generated when not supplied.

reason.description: Shown on the gate while the window is active.

cron.description: Standard 5-field cron marking the window start.

duration.description: How long the recurring window stays open, in nanoseconds.

start.description: Start of a one-off window, inclusive.

end.description: End of a one-off window, exclusive.

reason.description: Shown on the gate while the window is active.

cron.description: Standard 5-field cron marking the window start, e.g. `0 14 * * 5`. Pair with duration_seconds.

duration_seconds.description: How long a recurring window stays open. Pair with cron.

start.description: Start of a one-off window, inclusive. Pair with end.

end.description: End of a one-off window, exclusive. Pair with start.

ScheduleEntry.description: A stored window plus the gate it belongs to and whether it is in force now. The schedule's own fields are inlined.

reason.description: Shown on the gate while the window is active.

cron.description: Standard 5-field cron marking the window start.

duration.description: How long the recurring window stays open, in nanoseconds.

active.description: Whether the window contains the current time.

since.description: Start of the occurrence in force now. Present only while active.

until.description: End of the occurrence in force now. Present only while active.

version.description: Main module version: a semver tag, or (devel) for a build from a working tree.

revision.description: VCS commit the binary was built from. Absent when the build was not stamped.

dirty.description: Whether the working tree had uncommitted changes at build time.

error.description: What went wrong. Internal failures are logged in full and reported here only as "internal error".
